_what: THE ONE swappable list. The order of the 15 door-page sections, by name. build.js renders in this order and hardcodes no position. Melissa's ruling lands here as a one-line edit and nothing else in the kit changes.
_status: RULED by Melissa 2026-09-05: Order B. Her words: 'the order b is fine.' Give-before-you-ask - the page is useful even if she never starts the tool.
_constraints: HERO first, INTAKE second: INTAKE is a child of HERO's grid in the template — moving it out of HERO is a build change, not a reorder.
CLOSER last: it is the return to the intake; anything after it competes with the CTA.
RELATED (if present) directly before CLOSER: the two share one dark chapter (#related-closer).
A band (#band-1/2/3) belongs to the section it closes and travels with it.
VISUALS plate 2 names 'your 4 safe checks' — if VISUALS lands before SAFE_OBSERVATIONS the drawing forward-references a list the reader has not met yet (survivable, worth knowing).
